purpose: Teach: 山上/川本/和泉/玉田/三枝/寺田/岩井/しのぎ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「山上おじさんと一緒に登山したい」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho — your dad was saying he'd like to go hiking with Uncle Yamagami.
lines.style: Warm, conversational opening. Gentle delivery of secondhand information. Slight lift at the end, inviting his thoughts. Relaxed posture, leaning in slightly.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと川本おじさんの家に遊びに行ったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis — I went to visit Dad and Uncle Kawamoto's place!
lines.style: Bright, proud announcement. Quick pace on the first half. Emphasis on the outing itself — the accomplishment of going somewhere with Dad. Genuine smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「和泉さんとは古い友人」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho — your dad mentioned that Izumi-san and he have been friends for a long time.
lines.style: Reflective, unhurried. Slight pause before delivering the observation. Warm tone without pushing. Voice trails gently, letting the weight of 'old friendship' settle.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと玉田おじさんに会いに行ったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis — I went to meet Dad and Uncle Tamada!
lines.style: Eager, quick energy. Slight breathiness on the opening syllables. Emphasis on 'went to meet' — the action itself is exciting. Lighter, younger vocal quality.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「三枝おばさんはお料理上手」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho — your dad said Saegusa-san is really good at cooking.
lines.style: Soft, admiring tone. Gentle emphasis on 'good at cooking' — respect for a skill. Slow, measured pace. A small smile in the voice, not overdone.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと寺田家のお祝いに行ったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis — I went to Dad and the Terada family's celebration!
lines.style: Bright excitement building through the line. Quick pace, especially on the second half. The thrill of being included in a family celebration. Open, enthusiastic delivery.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「岩井さんとは長い付き合い」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho — your dad said he's had a long relationship with Iwai-san.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost wistful tone. Slower pace. Emphasis on 'long' — the weight of time and continuity. Voice opens space around the words, respecting the history being described.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんに「毎月のしのぎ、つまり生活費の工夫が大事」って教えて頂いたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis — Dad taught me that managing monthly expenses — you know, making smart choices about living costs — that's what really matters.
lines.style: Earnest, attentive delivery. Slight pause before 'making smart choices' to clarify the concept. Respectful tone — this is wisdom being shared. Slower pace. Ends with quiet conviction, not performance.
